exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures and match them to the animals in the list.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarga qarang va ularni ro'yxatdagi hayvonlarga moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
UNIT MAVZUSI — HAYVONLAR.

Sarlavha: 'Birds of a Feather!'
Bu maqolning qisqartmasi: 'Birds of a feather flock together'
  so'zma-so'z: bir xil patli qushlar birga uchadi
  ma'nosi: o'xshash odamlar birga bo'ladi
  o'zbekchada: 'Qush qushi bilan, quloq quloq bilan'

RO'YXAT: dolphin, lion, parrot, penguins

RASMLAR:
  A — suvdan sakrab chiqayotgan kulrang jonivor
  B — qizil, sariq va ko'k patli qush
  C — qora-oq rangli, tik turgan qushlar guruhi
  D — sariq yeli bor katta mushuksimon hayvon

answers.descEn: Picture A — a grey sea animal jumping out of the waves
answers.descUz: A-rasm: to'lqindan sakrab chiqayotgan kulrang dengiz jonivori

answers.descEn: Picture B — a bird with bright red, yellow and blue feathers and a long tail
answers.descUz: B-rasm: yorqin qizil, sariq va ko'k patli, uzun dumli qush

answers.descEn: Picture C — a group of black and white birds standing upright on the ice
answers.descUz: C-rasm: muz ustida tik turgan qora-oq qushlar guruhi

answers.descEn: Picture D — a large golden cat with a thick mane around its head
answers.descUz: D-rasm: boshi atrofida qalin yeli bor katta oltinrang mushuksimon hayvon

exercises.instructionEn: Which of them are birds? mammals? Which of them have fur, fins, a tail, skin, feathers, wings, a mane, legs? Which of them can fly, run, swim?
exercises.instructionUz: Ulardan qaysilari qush? sutemizuvchi? Qaysilarida jun, suzgich, dum, teri, pat, qanot, yol, oyoq bor? Qaysilari ucha, yugura, suza oladi?
exercises.explanationUz:
HAYVON TANASI QISMLARI:
  fur      — jun (sutemizuvchilarda)
  fins     — suzgichlar (baliq va delfinda)
  a tail   — dum
  skin     — teri (junsiz)
  feathers — patlar (qushlarda)
  wings    — qanotlar
  a mane   — yol (sherning bo'ynidagi soch)
  legs     — oyoqlar

IKKI GURUH HAYVON:
  birds (qushlar)      — pat va qanoti bor, tuxum qo'yadi
  mammals (sutemizuvchilar) — bola tug'adi va sut bilan boqadi

QIZIQ FAKTLAR:
  • Delfin — BALIQ EMAS, sutemizuvchi!
  • Pingvin — QUSH, lekin UCHA OLMAYDI!
  • Delfinning OYOG'I YO'Q va JUNI YO'Q — terisi bor.

items.whyUz: Qushlarda pat va qanot bor, tuxum qo'yadi. To'tiqush va pingvin — qush.
Sutemizuvchilar bola tug'adi va sut bilan boqadi. Delfin BALIQ EMAS — sutemizuvchi!
'fur' = jun. Faqat sherda. Delfinda teri (skin) bor, jun yo'q.
'fins' = suzgichlar. Suzishga yordam beradi.

items.textEn: Which of them have a tail?
items.whyUz: To'rttasida ham dum bor: delfin, sher, to'tiqush, pingvin.

items.textEn: Which of them have skin (without fur)?
items.whyUz: Matnda: 'They've got grey skin'. Delfinda jun yo'q — silliq teri.
'feathers' = patlar. Faqat qushlarda bo'ladi.
Pingvinda ham qanot BOR, lekin u ucha olmaydi — qanotlari suzish uchun.

items.textEn: Which of them have a mane?
items.whyUz: 'a mane' = yol (bo'yin sochi). Faqat ERKAK sherda bo'ladi.

options: the lion, the parrot and the penguins
items.answer: the lion, the parrot and the penguins
items.whyUz: Delfinda oyoq YO'Q. Matnda: 'They haven't got legs'.
Pingvin qush, lekin UCHA OLMAYDI. Matnda: 'they can't fly!'
Sher tez yuguradi. Pingvin yura oladi, lekin yugurmaydi.
Ikkalasi ham juda yaxshi suzadi. Matnda: 'They can swim very well'.

exercises.instructionEn: First, read these sentences, then listen and mark them as T (true) or F (false).
exercises.instructionUz: Avval bu gaplarni o'qing, so'ng tinglab, T (to'g'ri) yoki F (noto'g'ri) deb belgilang.
exercises.audioRequiredUz: Kitobda audio bor. Barcha javoblarni 3-mashqdagi matnlardan ham topish mumkin.
exercises.explanationUz:
Har bir gapni matndagi aniq ma'lumot bilan solishtiring.

CHALG'ITUVCHI JUFTLIKLAR:
  fur ↔ skin        (delfinda TERI, jun emas)
  wings — pingvinda BOR, lekin ucha olmaydi
  ten ↔ twenty years

items.whyUz: TO'G'RI. Matnning birinchi gapi: 'Dolphins are mammals.'
TO'G'RI. Matnda: 'Dolphins are not fish, but they live in water.'
NOTO'G'RI. Matnda 'grey SKIN' (teri), 'fur' (jun) EMAS. Delfinda jun yo'q.
TO'G'RI. Matnda: 'they eat fish'.
NOTO'G'RI. Matnda: 'they've got wings'. Qanoti BOR, lekin ucha olmaydi.
NOTO'G'RI. Matnda: 'they CAN'T fly!' Bu pingvinni g'ayrioddiy qush qiladi.
TO'G'RI. Matnda: 'Penguins live on the ice of Antarctica'.

items.sentence: 8  Penguins live for about ten years.
items.whyUz: NOTO'G'RI. Matnda: 'about TWENTY years'. O'n emas, yigirma.

exercises.explanationUz:
MATN TUZILISHI (hayvon tavsifining standart tartibi):
  1) turi (sutemizuvchi / qush)
  2) tanasi (nima bor, nima yo'q)
  3) og'irligi
  4) xarakteri va qobiliyati
  5) qayerda yashaydi
  6) nima yeydi
  7) qancha yashaydi

Bu tartib 6-unitda o'z hayvoningiz haqida yozganda ham kerak.

sentences.en: Dolphins are mammals.
sentences.uz: Delfinlar — sutemizuvchilar.
sentences.noteUz: 'a mammal' = sutemizuvchi. Ko'plikda 'mammals'.

sentences.en: They have babies and feed them on milk.
sentences.uz: Ular bola tug'adi va ularni sut bilan boqadi.
sentences.noteUz: Bu SUTEMIZUVCHINING ta'rifi. 'feed somebody ON something' — 'on' predlogi bilan.

sentences.en: Dolphins are not fish, but they live in water.
sentences.uz: Delfinlar baliq emas, lekin suvda yashaydi.
sentences.noteUz: Eng ko'p chalkashadigan fakt! 'fish' — ko'plikda ham 'fish'.

sentences.en: They can swim very well.
sentences.uz: Ular juda yaxshi suza oladi.
sentences.noteUz: 'can' + fe'l (asos shakli). 'very well' — juda yaxshi.

sentences.en: They haven't got legs.
sentences.uz: Ularning oyog'i yo'q.
sentences.noteUz: 'have got' inkori. Ko'plik ega → HAVEN'T.

sentences.en: They've got grey skin and a big smile.
sentences.uz: Ularning kulrang terisi va katta tabassumi bor.
sentences.noteUz: QALIN SO'Z: smile = tabassum. Delfinning og'zi tabassumga o'xshaydi.

sentences.en: They've also got fins and a tail to help them swim.
sentences.uz: Yana suzishga yordam beradigan suzgichlari va dumi bor.
sentences.noteUz: 'to help them swim' — maqsad. 'help somebody DO' — 'to' KERAK EMAS.

sentences.en: They weigh from seventy to five hundred kilos.
sentences.uz: Ular yetmishdan besh yuz kilogrammgacha og'irlikda.
sentences.noteUz: QALIN SO'Z: weigh = og'irlikda bo'lmoq. O'qilishi /weɪ/ — 'gh' o'qilmaydi!

sentences.en: Dolphins are very intelligent animals.
sentences.uz: Delfinlar juda aqlli hayvonlar.
sentences.noteUz: QALIN SO'Z: intelligent = aqlli. 'clever' bilan bir xil, lekin kuchliroq.

sentences.en: They can easily learn how to play games and are friendly to people.
sentences.uz: Ular o'yin o'ynashni oson o'rganadi va odamlarga do'stona munosabatda bo'ladi.
sentences.noteUz:
QALIN SO'ZLAR: easily = oson; friendly = do'stona.
'friendly TO somebody' — predlog shart.

sentences.en: Dolphins live in warm seas in many different parts of the world.
sentences.uz: Delfinlar dunyoning ko'p turli qismlaridagi iliq dengizlarda yashaydi.
sentences.noteUz: QALIN SO'ZLAR: warm seas = iliq dengizlar; parts of the world = dunyo qismlari.

sentences.en: They live in small groups and they eat fish.
sentences.uz: Ular kichik guruhlarda yashaydi va baliq yeydi.
sentences.noteUz: QALIN SO'Z: groups = guruhlar. 'live IN groups' — predlog shart.

sentences.en: They live for about fifty years.
sentences.uz: Ular taxminan ellik yil yashaydi.
sentences.noteUz: 'live FOR + davomiylik' — 'for' shart. 'about' = taxminan.

exercises.explanationUz:
PINGVIN — G'AYRIODDIY QUSH.

U qushning barcha belgilariga ega:
  tuxum qo'yadi (lay eggs)
  qanoti bor (wings)
  pati bor (feathers)

LEKIN UCHA OLMAYDI! Buning o'rniga juda yaxshi suzadi.
Qanotlari suv ostida 'eshkak' vazifasini bajaradi.

sentences.en: Penguins lay eggs and they've got wings, so they are like other birds, but they can't fly!
sentences.uz: Pingvinlar tuxum qo'yadi va qanotlari bor, shuning uchun ular boshqa qushlarga o'xshaydi, lekin ucha olmaydi!
sentences.noteUz:
QALIN SO'ZLAR: lay eggs = tuxum qo'ymoq.
'so' = shuning uchun. 'like other birds' = boshqa qushlar kabi.

sentences.en: They can swim very well, though.
sentences.uz: Lekin ular juda yaxshi suza oladi.
sentences.noteUz: 'though' gap OXIRIDA — 'lekin, esa' ma'nosida.

sentences.en: They are black and white, and they've got small wings, very short legs and a short tail.
sentences.uz: Ular qora va oq rangda, kichik qanotlari, juda kalta oyoqlari va kalta dumi bor.
sentences.noteUz: Rang: 'black and white' — tartib o'zgarmaydi.

sentences.en: They've also got thick feathers to keep them warm in cold water.
sentences.uz: Yana sovuq suvda issiq saqlash uchun qalin patlari bor.
sentences.noteUz:
QALIN SO'ZLAR: thick = qalin; warm = issiq; cold water = sovuq suv.
'keep somebody warm' = issiq saqlamoq.

sentences.en: They weigh about twenty kilos.
sentences.uz: Ular taxminan yigirma kilogramm keladi.
sentences.noteUz: Delfin 70–500 kg, pingvin esa atigi 20 kg.

sentences.en: Penguins look funny when they walk.
sentences.uz: Pingvinlar yurganda kulgili ko'rinadi.
sentences.noteUz: QALIN SO'Z: funny = kulgili. 'look' + sifat = ...ko'rinadi.

sentences.en: However, when they are in the water, they swim like fish.
sentences.uz: Ammo suvda bo'lganda ular baliqdek suzadi.
sentences.noteUz:
'However' = ammo (gap boshida, vergul bilan).
'like fish' = baliq kabi.

sentences.en: Penguins live on the ice of Antarctica and in the sea around it.
sentences.uz: Pingvinlar Antarktida muzida va uning atrofidagi dengizda yashaydi.
sentences.noteUz: QALIN SO'Z: ice = muz. 'ON the ice' — yuza → ON. 'around' = atrofida.

sentences.en: They live in big groups and they eat fish.
sentences.uz: Ular katta guruhlarda yashaydi va baliq yeydi.
sentences.noteUz: Delfin KICHIK guruhlarda, pingvin KATTA guruhlarda.

sentences.en: They live for about twenty years.
sentences.uz: Ular taxminan yigirma yil yashaydi.
sentences.noteUz: Delfin 50 yil, pingvin 20 yil.

exercises.instructionEn: Find three ways that dolphins are like penguins.
exercises.instructionUz: Delfinlar pingvinlarga qanday uch jihatdan o'xshashligini toping.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI MATNNI SOLISHTIRING va O'XSHASH faktlarni toping.

O'XSHASHLIKNI IFODALASH:
  Both dolphins and penguins + fe'l (ko'plik, -s YO'Q)
  = Delfinlar ham, pingvinlar ham ...

  'both' = ikkalasi ham. Ega oldida turadi.

MATNLARDA BIR XIL AYTILGAN GAPLAR:
  'They can swim very well.'  — ikkala matnda ham
  'They live in ... groups.'  — ikkala matnda ham
  'They eat fish.'            — ikkala matnda ham

items.answer: Both dolphins and penguins can swim very well.
items.whyUz: Ikkala matnda ham 'They can swim very well' deyilgan.

items.answer: Both dolphins and penguins live in groups.
items.whyUz: Delfin — 'small groups', pingvin — 'big groups'. Ikkalasi ham guruhda.

items.answer: Both dolphins and penguins eat fish.
items.whyUz: Ikkala matnda ham 'they eat fish' deyilgan.

items.answer: Both dolphins and penguins have got a tail.
items.whyUz: Delfin — 'a tail', pingvin — 'a short tail'.

items.answer: Both dolphins and penguins live in or near the sea.
items.whyUz: Delfin dengizda, pingvin muzda va dengizda.

exercises.explanationUz: Ikki matndagi 14 ta qalin so'z — Unit 6 ning asosiy lug'ati.

items.whyUz: 'a big smile' — delfinning og'zi tabassumga o'xshaydi.
O'qilishi /weɪ/ — 'gh' o'qilmaydi! Ot shakli: weight (og'irlik).
'clever' dan kuchliroq. Ot: intelligence (aql).
'easy' (oson) + -ly = ravish. y → i.
'friendly TO somebody' — predlog shart. '-ly' bilan tugasa ham SIFAT.
'sea' → 'seas'. Delfin iliq suvda yashaydi.
'part OF' — predlog shart.
'live IN groups' — guruhda yashamoq.
'lay' — qo'ymoq (tuxum). 'lie' (yotmoq) bilan chalkashtirmang.
'thick feathers' = qalin patlar. Aksi: thin (yupqa).
'keep them warm' = ularni issiq saqlaydi. 'hot' dan yumshoqroq.
'water' — sanalmaydigan ot.
'look funny' = kulgili ko'rinmoq. 'fun' (zavq) + -ny.
'ON the ice' — yuza → ON. Sanalmaydigan ot.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the texts again, and answer the questions.
exercises.instructionUz: Matnlarni qayta o'qing va savollarga javob bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
SAVOL TURLARI:
  What can ... do?  — qobiliyat (can bilan)
  Where do ... live? — joy
  How long do ... live? — davomiylik
  Why ...?          — sabab (because bilan javob)
  What have ... got? — egalik (have got bilan)
  What do ... eat?  — ovqat

Javobda 'They' bilan boshlang — hayvonlar ko'plikda.

items.textEn: 1  What can dolphins do very well?
items.whyUz: Matnda: 'They can swim very well.' 'can' bilan savol → 'can' bilan javob.

items.answer: They live in warm seas in many different parts of the world.
items.whyUz: Joy savoli. Matndan to'liq javob.

items.answer: They live for about fifty years.
items.whyUz: 'How long' — davomiylik. 'live FOR' — 'for' shart.
'Why' → 'Because'. Pingvin qush, lekin ucha olmaydi — bu g'ayrioddiy. 'unusual' = g'ayrioddiy.

items.textEn: 5  What have penguins got to keep them warm?
items.whyUz: 'have got' bilan savol → 'have got' bilan javob. Matnda: 'thick feathers to keep them warm'.
Matnda: 'they eat fish'. 'fish' — ko'plikda ham 'fish'.

wordFormation.introUz: 40-bet — hayvon tanasi qismlari va sifat yasalishi.

groups.ruleUz: Hayvon tanasi — qaysi hayvonda nima bor
groups.explanationUz: Har bir so'z ma'lum hayvon guruhiga tegishli.
Otga -y qo'shilsa, 'shu xususiyatga ega' ma'nosidagi sifat chiqadi.
Sifatga -ly qo'shilsa ravish chiqadi. LEKIN 'friendly' — istisno (u sifat).
Bu otlarga -s qo'shilmaydi va fe'l birlikda bo'ladi.
Yozilishi va o'qilishi mos kelmaydigan so'zlar.

patterns.exampleEn: Dolphins are mammals. They have babies and feed them on milk.
patterns.exampleUz: Delfinlar — sutemizuvchilar. Ular bola tug'adi va sut bilan boqadi.
patterns.explanationUz:
Hayvonlar haqida umumiy gap KO'PLIKDA aytiladi —
shuning uchun fe'l -s OLMAYDI.

patterns.formula: They've got + tana qismi. / They haven't got + tana qismi.
patterns.exampleEn: They've got grey skin and a big smile. They haven't got legs.
patterns.exampleUz: Ularning kulrang terisi va katta tabassumi bor. Oyog'i yo'q.
patterns.explanationUz: 'have got' — egalik. Ko'plik ega → HAVE/HAVEN'T got.

patterns.exampleEn: They can swim very well. They can't fly!
patterns.exampleUz: Ular juda yaxshi suza oladi. Ucha olmaydi!
patterns.explanationUz: 'can' dan keyin fe'l ASOS shaklida — 'to' va '-s' YO'Q.

patterns.formula: They weigh + og'irlik. / They weigh FROM ... TO ...
patterns.exampleEn: They weigh about twenty kilos. They weigh from seventy to five hundred kilos.
patterns.exampleUz: Ular taxminan yigirma kilo keladi. Yetmishdan besh yuz kilogacha.

patterns.formula: They live IN + joy. They live FOR + davomiylik.
patterns.exampleEn: They live in warm seas. They live for about fifty years.
patterns.exampleUz: Ular iliq dengizlarda yashaydi. Taxminan ellik yil yashaydi.
patterns.explanationUz: Joy uchun IN/ON, umr davomiyligi uchun FOR.

patterns.formula: They've got ... TO KEEP them warm.
patterns.exampleEn: They've also got thick feathers to keep them warm in cold water.
patterns.exampleUz: Yana sovuq suvda issiq saqlash uchun qalin patlari bor.
patterns.explanationUz:
'to + fe'l' — MAQSAD ('...ish uchun').
'keep somebody warm' — issiq saqlamoq.

patterns.exampleEn: Both dolphins and penguins can swim very well.
patterns.exampleUz: Delfinlar ham, pingvinlar ham juda yaxshi suza oladi.
